parts.name: Green Tile
parts.desc: After a monster is played here, summon an enemy {Papyrus Statue}, and this effect expires.

parts.name: Yellow Tile
parts.desc: After a monster is played here, deal 3 DMG to all other ally monsters, and this effect expires.

parts.name: Purple Tile
parts.desc: After a monster is played here, it is instead summoned for the opponent, and this effect expires.

parts.name: Orange Tile
parts.desc: After a monster is played here, the enemy draws 3 cards, and this effect expires.

parts.name: Strange Machine
parts.desc: This takes 1 less DMG for each enemy slot enchantment. Magic: Enchant enemy slots with a _Green_, _Yellow_, _Purple_, and _Orange Tile_.
